calibration_review.pre_dispatch_exposure: Registration message counts/status only; no source bodies, semantic notes, questions/oracle/model outputs. Parent verified stable index byte/hash bindings without semantic reads.
read_paths: registered plan and fingerprint metadata only
calibration_review.scope: Independently review whole public2 completed meetings + related general1, new synthetic2 meetings + general1, applicable license/revision/provenance/actual ingestion and semantic freshness. No author source edits. Freeze only accepted corpus. Return counts/hash/status to parent; semantic notes stay unread by parent.

validation_source_v2.prior_exposure: Own closed v1 source body3/license3 including one duplicate and uninspected patch payload1; project aggregate and generic code/plan. No other split semantics/questions/oracle/model outputs.
validation_source_v2.preferred_source: Official W3C project documents with explicit applicable document license; GitHub or official website. No platform-only requirement.
validation_source_v2.reserve_before_bodies: Send metadata-only repository+exact commit or official group+specific URL candidates to parent before license/source body fetch. For official non-versioned pages bind requested/final URL, UTC, content type/charset, raw bytes SHA256 and applicable license snapshot; ETag/LastModified alone is not immutable identity.
validation_source_v2.input_formats: Use existing TXT/Markdown/text-PDF pipeline only. HTML-only material requires a separate implementation decision; do not silently strip markup or create a new parser in this source assignment.
validation_source_v2.freshness: Also exclude bound original19 and prior fingerprints; cross-platform mirrors and exact/semantic duplicates still excluded. Do not read past source bodies to fill metadata gaps.
validation_source_v2.actual_ingestion: Parent-serialized Java, isolated database/ports, generation/inference disabled. Reuse verified JAR SHA8476ba7728f392e62aa53a3999de8d2f08982012dc2a345f503bedb59564976b. Source /documents parity is not meeting autoanalysis proof.
validation_source_v2.output_contract: Whole raw/license/provenance, processed/chunk artifacts, manifest/fingerprints, author receipt/network log, artifact-index-v2.json and safe-summary-v2.json. Unlicensed discovery bodies stay local. Parent safe counts/hash/identity only. Exclude ephemeral SQLite -shm/-wal from final durable artifact index; close handles before hashing.
validation_source_v2.source_acceptance: Pending separate independent reviewer; no author self-acceptance.

common_prohibited: source trimming or fabricated public meeting completion
user approval or human review claims
